description_zh: 创建Tair VNode虚拟节点实例
kebab_example: aliyun r-kvstore create-tair-kv-cache-vnode --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-beijing-f --instance-class kvcache.cu.g4b.2 --compute-unit-num 1 --vk-name tk-2ze4bba3c8fe0000 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1e7clcw529l773d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTairKVCacheVNode

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where you want to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。使用此参数指定要创建实例的地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone where you want to create the instance
parameters.help_zh: 可用区ID。使用此参数指定要创建实例的可用区
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the new instance. The name must be 2 to 80 characters long and must start with a letter (case-insensitive) or a Chinese character. Spaces and the following special characters are not supported: `@/:=”<>{[]}`
parameters.help_zh: 新的实例名称。名称为2~80个字符，以大小写英文字母或中文开头，不支持空格及特殊字符：`@/:=”<>{[]}`
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en: The instance specification
parameters.help_zh: 实例规格
parameters.name: instance_class

parameters.help_en: The number of compute units. Currently, only one compute unit is supported
parameters.help_zh: 计算单元数量，目前仅支持1个计算单元
parameters.name: compute_unit_num

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual cluster that hosts the VNode
parameters.help_zh: VNode所在VCluster虚拟集群实例ID
parameters.name: vk_name

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch for the instance. The vSwitch must belong to the VPC that is associated with the specified virtual cluster. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html operation to obtain the vSwitch ID.

The vSwitch must be in the same zone as the instance
parameters.help_zh:
本实例的虚拟交换机ID，需要从属于指定VCluster虚拟集群的专有网络VPC，可调用专有网络VPC的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/35739.html获取。
虚拟交换机所属的可用区需和本实例相同
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method for the instance. Valid value:

PrePaid: Subscription. If you specify this value, you must also specify the Period parameter
parameters.help_zh:
要转换到的付费类型，取值：
PrePaid：包年包月，传入本值时，您还需要传入Period参数
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period in months. Valid values: 1 to 9, 12, 24, and 36.

This parameter is required when the ChargeType parameter is set to PrePaid
parameters.help_zh:
付费周期，单位为月，取值：1~9、12、24、36。
当ChargeType取值为PrePaid时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: Additional business information, such as a promotion ID
parameters.help_zh: 活动ID、业务信息等扩展信息
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en: The coupon code
parameters.help_zh: 优惠码
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:

true: Use a coupon.

false (default): Do not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用代金券，取值：
true：使用代金券。
false（默认）：不使用代金券
parameters.name: auto_use_coupon

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Enables auto-renewal.

false (default): Disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启自动续费，取值：
true：开启。
false（默认）：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period, in months. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, 6, and 12.

This parameter is required when the AutoRenew parameter is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位为月，取值：1、2、3、6、12。
当AutoRenew取值为true时，本参数必须传入
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance will belong.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation or view resource group IDs in the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html.

Before changing the resource group of an instance, call the [ListResources](158866) API to view the current resource group of the instance
parameters.help_zh:
目标资源组ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html接口或通过控制台获取资源组ID列表。相关操作，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151181.html。
修改实例所属的资源组之前，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158866.html接口查看实例现在所属的资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically complete the payment. The value must be true
parameters.help_zh: 自动支付，取值固定为true
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en: A client-generated token that ensures request idempotence. This token must be unique across requests, is case-sensitive, and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

fields.help_en:
The tag key.

You can specify up to 5 tag key-value pairs at a time
fields.help_zh:
标签的键，与Tag Value组成标签的键值对。
单次最多支持传入5组标签的键值对
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value.

N represents the index of a tag, starting from 1. For example, Tag.1.Value is the value of the first tag
fields.help_zh:
标签的值。
N表示传入第几个标签的值。例如Tag.1.Value表示传入第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示传入第二个标签的值
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags to add to the instance. You can specify a maximum of five tags
parameters.help_zh: 实例的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: Performs a dry run and does not create the instance. The system checks the request parameters, request format, business limits, and available inventory. If the check fails, the system returns the corresponding error. If the check passes, the system returns the `DryRunOperation` error code.

false (default): Sends a normal request. If the check passes, the system creates the instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否对本次创建实例的操作执行预检查，取值：
true：执行预检查操作，不创建实例。检查项目包含请求参数、请求格式、业务限制和库存。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认）：发送正常请求，通过检查后直接创建实例
parameters.name: dry_run
